description_en: Modifies the name and description of a deployment set
description_zh: 修改一个部署集的名称和描述信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-deployment-set-attribute --deployment-set-id ds-bp1frxuzdg87zh4p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDeploymentSetAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deployment set
parameters.name: deployment_set_id

parameters.help_en: The new description of the deployment set. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 新的部署集描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The new name of the deployment set. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain characters that are categorized as letter in Unicode, including Chinese characters, English letters, and digits. The name can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 新的部署集名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: deployment_set_name

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the deployment set. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 部署集所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The affinity level of the deployment set. Instances in the deployment set are distributed based on this affinity level. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 1.
<notice>The affinity setting is available only when the deployment strategy is set to high availability (`Strategy = Availability`).></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
部署集的亲和度级别，在部署集的实例会按该亲和度分布，取值范围：1-10，默认为1。
<notice>亲和度设置仅在部署策略为高可用(`Strategy = Availability`)可用。></notice>
parameters.name: affinity
